titulo: Von der Leyen says Hungary 'strengthened rule of law', unlocks €4.2bn in EU funding
cuerpo: The European Commission has unlocked €4.2 billion in cohesion funds for Hungary and reopened Erasmus+ and Horizon Europe access, after PM Péter Magyar's government met EU rule-of-law conditions. Brussels froze the funds in 2022 over corruption and procurement concerns under the Orbán government.
